chunks: Al-Hussein bin Ibrahim (mercy of God be upon him) narrated from Ahmad bin Yahya, from Bakr bin Abdullah, from Muhammad bin Ubaidullah, from Ali bin al-Hakam, from Hisham, from Abu Hamza ath-Themali, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad bin Ali, from his fathers (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): 'For any believer in whose heart your love is established, if his foot slips on the Path (Sirat), his foot will remain firm until God admits him to Paradise through your love.'

key_terms.الصِّرَاط: The Path (Sirat), the bridge over Hell on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.حُبُّكَ: Your love (referring to love for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: How does love for Imam Ali ensure entry into Paradise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in Fadail al-Shia, this hadith highlights the Shia doctrine of 'Hubb al-Ali' as a metaphysical anchor for believers during the critical trial of crossing the Sirat. It underscores the intercessory role of Imam Ali (as), suggesting that his love compensates for minor spiritual lapses, ensuring divine mercy and entry into Paradise.
